tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Previous and present details of similar work carried with Govt. of Karnataka and any other institutions
Printing Unit Registration Details. (copies of registration)
The printing unit must own CTP Unit, Heatset web offset machine and online pinning machineries.

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last 3 years, i.e. latest 3 years Financial Statements / Income Tax Statements Achieved in at least 2 financial years to minimum turnover of Rs.75 lakhs. Printer should have satisfactorily carried out one similar work for any government department/institution at a cost of Rs.50 lakhs. In any one year during past 3 years. The bidders should enclose the certificate from the concerned department/Institution to the effect that he has satisfactorily completed the printing work. Mere work order issued shall not be accepted as experience certificate.
